name: Drawer
use: use for one task step on top of the page: a form of about five fields, a count, a picker, a short read (sized to its content, a handle, a close).
notUse: not for a long record or a sub-page with its own back-stack — use page; not for a yes/no decision — use dialog; never a drawer on a drawer — replace its content

name: Page
use: use for a full sub-page the worker works in: a record, a log, an overview, a form with more than five fields (the whole canvas, Back in the footer).
notUse: not for a single question — use drawer or dialog; not for a top-level destination — that is a screen of the task, not a sheet

name: Dialog
use: use for one small decision over a sheet or page: confirm, correct one value, answer yes or no.
notUse: not for a form — use drawer; not for a message with no choice — use Banner or Status
